name: paper-pdf-translator
description: Translate research-paper PDFs into a layout-preserving PDF or a side-by-side reading page with AI questions; local model or Claude / Codex subscription, no API key. 把論文 PDF 翻成保留排版的 PDF，或左譯右原、可問 AI 的閱讀頁。

interface.shortDescription: 論文 PDF 翻譯：保留排版的 PDF，或左譯右原可問 AI 的閱讀頁
interface.longDescription: Translate research-paper PDFs, by default from English into Traditional Chinese. Output a translated PDF that keeps the layout, or a reading page with each original page beside its translation and a panel for asking AI; the reading page also handles Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, Spanish and French. Includes term protection, a review pass and mechanical checks; the translation is not human-checked. 把論文 PDF 翻成中文（預設英翻台灣繁中）：保留排版的譯文 PDF，或左譯文、右原文整頁並可問 AI 的閱讀頁；閱讀頁另支援簡中、日、韓、德、西、法文。附術語保護、對照原文校對與機械檢查，譯文未經人工校對。
defaultPrompt: @Paper PDF Translator 把 paper.pdf 的前兩頁翻成中文給我看
@Paper PDF Translator 把這篇論文翻成原文與譯文並排的 PDF
